# Support

- **Bugs and feature requests:** open an issue using the
  [bug report](../../issues/new?template=bug_report.yml) or
  [feature request](../../issues/new?template=feature_request.yml) template.
- **Usage questions:** read the [user guide](../docs/USER_GUIDE.md) and
  [install / troubleshooting](../docs/INSTALL.md) first; if they do not answer your
  question, open an issue with the `question` label.
- **Security issues:** never in public issues — see
  [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).
- **Current project state and known limitations:**
  [HANDOFF.md](../HANDOFF.md) and [docs/PROJECT_STATUS.md](../docs/PROJECT_STATUS.md).
